items.Sentence: Screened effluent is discharged to one of two parallel facultative lagoons.

The WWTF features a headworks, dual facultative lagoon system operated in parallel, and two disposal ponds. Each lagoon is equipped with a 5-horsepower aerator, and has a total depth of 7.5 feet, including two feet of freeboard.

Each disposal pond has a total bottom area 10.6 acres, and each pond is approximately 3.9 feet deep, including two feet of freeboard. The resulting volume for one disposal pond at the operating depth of 1.9 feet is approximately 20 acre-feet, which provides about 40 acre-feet of total storage.

Currently, the County does not remove sludge from the treatment ponds but proposes to do so in the future to improve WWTF performance. One treatment pond is planned to be taken out of service during the summer to allow accumulated sludge to dry prior to removal.
